properties.name: geo-ip.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the GeoIP provider, for example https://ipwho.is.

properties.name: geo-ip.connect-timeout
properties.description: Connect timeout of the GeoIP call, for example 2s.

properties.name: geo-ip.read-timeout
properties.description: Read timeout of the GeoIP call, for example 2s.

properties.name: geo-ip.excluded-addresses
properties.description: Addresses refused without calling the provider, for example 127.0.0.1,::1.
